Work item slot setting - the maid does not store "items in this slot" in the chest.
When enabled, maids will spawn naturally.
Even if disabled, you can still meet maids by crafting spawn eggs.
When enabled, wild maids will despawn.

Minimum light level required for natural maid spawning.
Maids will only spawn in areas brighter than this value.

Specifies biomes where maids naturally spawn using tags.
Direct biome ID specification is not supported.

Specifies biomes where maids will NOT spawn using tags.
Direct biome ID specification is not supported.
Spawn weight for maids. Higher values make maids spawn more frequently.
Minimum number of maids that spawn together in a single spawn event.
Maximum number of maids that spawn together in a single spawn event.

When enabled, wild maids spawn with silent voices.
This does not affect already spawned wild maids.

Wild maids spawn with the specified sound pack.
This does not affect already spawned wild maids.
Specification must match exactly, and available sound packs can be checked from the sound pack list.
If no match is found, the specification is ignored.

Interval at which maids consume salary to heal themselves.
Unit is ticks.
Amount of health maids restore when consuming salary to heal themselves.
Health threshold for delaying healing to prevent action cancellation.

When enabled, maids will not die.
They still take damage, so salary will be consumed for healing.
Base melee damage dealt by a rebelling maid to the proxy entity in non-battle mode (can be blocked by a shield).
Damage taken by maids is multiplied by this factor.
Damage taken by battle mode maids is multiplied by this factor.
Damage taken by non-battle mode maids is multiplied by this factor.
When enabled, friendly attacks will hit maids.
When enabled, maids will not take damage from entities marked as attack-prohibited in the targeting system.
When enabled, maids will avoid dangerous blocks and high falls.

When enabled, maids take no damage whatsoever. They are invincible.
Except for void damage and creative mode.
When enabled, maids become immune to fall damage.
When enabled, maids will not take damage from non-mob sources.
Movement speed of maids in freedom mode.

Limit radius for maids in follow mode.
Centered on the player; circular, with the specified value as the radius.
Movement speed of maids in tracer mode.

Horizontal range for maids to track redstone in tracer mode.
Range is square, with ± the specified value as the range.

Vertical range for maids to track redstone in tracer mode.
Range is square, with ± the specified value as the range.
Movement speed of maids in follow mode.
Distance at which maids start following in follow mode.
Distance at which maids stop following in follow mode.
Sprint movement speed of maids in follow mode.
Distance at which maids start sprinting in follow mode.
Distance at which maids stop sprinting in follow mode.
Distance at which maids start teleporting in follow mode.

Width of teleport destination range centered on the master.
If set to 3, maids will teleport within a -3 to 3 range.

Height of teleport destination range centered on the master.
If set to 1, maids will teleport within a -1 to 1 range.

When enabled, maids can teleport to the front of the owner.
This might be a little annoying.

Range in front of the owner.
Range is square, with the specified value as one side.
Maximum number of teleport attempts per tick.
Movement speed when maids go to pick up items.

Range in which maids go to pick up items.
Range is circular, with the specified value as the radius.
Default: 12.

Frequency at which maids go to pick up items.
If set to 20, they will execute once every 20 ticks.
Pick Up Items Near Owner When Following

When OFF (default), maids also pick up dropped items near their owner while following.
When ON, maids won't pick up items in front of the owner (to avoid taking loot in front of them).

When filled with item Tag IDs (e.g. minecraft:logs, littlemaidmobresurgence:maids_salary), maids will only actively pick up items matching any of these tags.
Leave empty to pick up all pickupable items.
Movement speed when wild maids are fleeing.

Base interval in ticks for pathfinding recalculation.
Used by follow, teleport, combat, and work modes.
Some modes use double this value for less urgent tasks.

Default number of work item slots.
Individual settings can be configured from the maid inventory.
Fencer attack distance is multiplied by this factor.
Fencer attack rate is multiplied by this factor.

Archer shooting distance is multiplied by this factor.
By the way, maids try to maintain between 100% and 75% of their shooting distance.

Archer shooting velocity is multiplied by this factor.
By the way, arrow damage increases with velocity.

Light level threshold for torcher to place lights.
Lights are placed in areas with light level below this threshold.

Radius (blocks) shared by block work, container search, farmer search, and freedom mode.
Also the radius bound by the maid stick.

Maximum number of blocks to search for block work modes.
Higher values may impact performance.
Block Work Search Budget Per Tick

Number of blocks searched per tick for block work modes.
Higher values find targets faster but use more CPU.

Multiplier for torcher search count.
Search count = distance^2 * this value.

Interval in ticks between searches for shearable mobs.
Unit is ticks.

Interval at which salary is consumed.
Unit is ticks.

Maximum number of days maids will tolerate unpaid salary.
If exceeded, they will go on strike. Prepare some cake.
Max Auto Salary Receipt Slot Size

Maximum slot size for auto salary receipt.
If set to 3, maids will try to receive up to 3 stacks of salary.

Salary slot threshold to start auto salary receipt.
If set to 1, maids will try to receive salary when they have 1 slot or less.

Number of salary box positions that can be memorized.
Note: Empty salary boxes are ignored.

Distance to search for salary boxes.
Note: The distance for maids to memorize salary boxes is set separately.
Interval to start receiving salary from salary boxes.
Auto Salary Receipt Path Finding Interval
Interval for pathfinding to salary boxes.
Max Move Time for Auto Salary Receipt

Maximum time that can be spent moving to a salary box.
If it takes longer, they will give up.
Max Move Time After Auto Salary Receipt

Maximum time that can be spent returning to waiting position.
If it takes longer, they will give up.
When enabled, maids can pick up items.
When enabled, maids can pick up experience orbs.

When enabled, wild maids can pick up items.
Items picked up by wild maids cannot be retrieved unless you defeat them or hire them.

When enabled, you can get milk from maids.

...Pervert! Weirdo! Inhuman!

Range at which maids passively pick up items and experience orbs that are on the ground.
Unit is blocks.

Interval at which maids make sounds.
They will only make a sound once during the specified interval.
Unit is ticks.
Range in which maids look at you when you hold salary.
Range in which maids follow you when you hold salary.
Range in which maids look at you when you hold cake.
Range in which maids follow you when you hold cake.
Maximum number consumed during gunpowder acceleration.
Length of acceleration ticks per gunpowder.
Experience points required to convert a glass bottle into an experience bottle.

Entity attribute controlling target detection range.
Requires game restart. Only applies to newly spawned maids.
Existing maids keep their previous value.

Interval in ticks between target recalculations.
Lower values make maids more responsive but use more CPU.
Range in which maids detect targets and perform preemptive attacks.
Range in which maids actually perform combat actions.
Distance to keep from dangerous targets like Creepers when avoiding them.

Ratio of maids that attack the same target to prevent concentrated attacks.
50% of maids will attack the same target.

Maximum number of maids that can simultaneously attack one target.
Prevents concentrated attacks.

Health threshold at which maids are considered injured.
Maids with 50% or less health are considered injured.
Number of ticks during which an attack is considered valid for targeting decisions.
When enabled, maids maintain their wait pose even when moved while waiting.
How far the model is lowered (in blocks) when sitting in the rest state, so hips/legs touch the ground instead of floating.
Duration (ticks) of the off-hand sugar-holding consume animation (20 ticks = 1 second).
Mood lost when the maid is attacked.
Extra mood lost when attacked by the owner.
Favorability lost when attacked by the owner.
Duration of the angry state after being attacked (ticks).
The maid is considered angry when mood is below this value.
The target mood value that slowly recovers to.
Mood lost each time a leashed maid plays her leashed speech bubble.
Favorability lost each time a leashed maid plays her leashed speech bubble; no loss at max favorability level.
When enabled, maids show speech bubbles above their heads.
How long the speech bubble is displayed (ticks).
Minimum interval (ticks) for maids to speak on their own.
Maids speak low-health lines when health is below this percentage.
Volume of the maid's voice lines (0.0 - 1.0).
When enabled, the maid model renders with transparency/alpha support.
When enabled, detailed debug logs are printed while loading maid models, textures and sounds.

Range at which maids detect and collect from the Sugar Box.
Unit is blocks.
Interval (in ticks) at which maids check the Sugar Box for items to collect.
Range (in blocks) around you in which right-clicking the Maid Stick toggles the waiting state of your contracted maids.
Range (in blocks) around you in which sneaking and right-clicking the Maid Stick teleports your contracted maids to your side.
Interval (ticks) for hunger to decrease by 1.
Maids auto-eat food from inventory when hunger is below this value.
When enabled, maids also eat when health is low even if not hungry, to speed up recovery.
Health ratio that triggers low-health eating (1=100%, 0.5=50%).
Extra health restored when the maid auto-eats.
Favorability gained when the maid auto-eats.
Mood gained when the maid auto-eats.
Interval (ticks) for checking whether to eat.
In the 'Always Eat' mode, interval (ticks) between each meal (600 = 30 seconds).
When hunger is above this percentage, consume the surplus hunger to restore health (1% hunger = 1 HP); no consumption when health is full.
Satiety percentage restored each time the maid consumes sugar (auto or fed by the player).
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.hurt.angr: Ouch! What do you think you're doing!
Why did you hit me! I didn't do anything!
Oww... that was so mean, I'll remember this!
Why... would you do this to me...
It hurts... could you be gentler...
Waaah... it hurts... I'm going to cry...
I'm sorry... did I do something wrong...
It hurts... it hurts... I hate this...
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.fed.low.2: Hmph, I won't forgive you for just a bit of food.
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.fed.mid.3: Hehe, anything from master tastes great!
Anything master gives me is the sweetest in the world!
I'm so glad I met master~
Ahh, master is so kind, I'm so happy~
Hehe, can I have a bit more~
Let me grab a bite to keep my strength up~
A little hungry, let me snack on something.
I need to eat to keep working well.
A little snack... master won't notice, right?
Let me eat something to recover~
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.lowhp.1: It hurts... I can't go on...
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.lowhp.3: It hurts... I need to rest...
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.lowhp.6: Master... I think I'm about to fall...
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.evade.2: Too dangerous, I can't fight on...
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.evade.3: Let me keep my distance first!
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.rest.1: ...My wounds hurt... let me sit a bit...
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.rest.2: Let me rest a moment to recover...
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.rest.3: A short break and I'll be fine...
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.leashed.a: Let me go! I hate being leashed!
How dare you leash me?! Untie me now!
Untie me! Being leashed makes me furious!
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.leashed.s: Why am I tied up... I don't like this...
Being leashed feels awful... could you let me go...
I don't want to be leashed... it hurts...
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.leashed.c: I don't want to be leashed... but I'll put up with it.
Walking on a leash is annoying... just untie me.
I really dislike being leashed... oh well.
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.leashed.h: Walking with master is nice... but I still hate this leash!
This leash is so annoying... though I do enjoy your company.
I'd be happier without the leash... I don't like being tied up!
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.work.4: Hmph~ this work is nothing for me!
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.work.5: I'll do my best for master!
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.work.6: After this, I'll take a little break~
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.work.7: A hard-working maid is cute? Hehe~
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.work.8: If master is happy, I'm happy!
Hmph, I don't want to talk to you.
Hmm~ the weather is nice today.
I'll guard the house well today~
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.idle.high: I'll serve master well today too!
Will master praise me... I can't wait~
I want to stay by master's side forever~
Hehe, master's smile is so nice~
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.hungry.2: Ahh... I want to eat something...
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.hungry.3: My stomach is growling... how embarrassing...
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.hungry.5: I'm hungry... let me eat something first.
Please take care of me from now on, master!
Master, I'll always be with you!
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.strike.1: Hmph, I won't work if you don't pay!
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.strike.2: Strike! Strike! No cake, no work!
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.strike.3: Master is too stingy... I'm going on strike!
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.thanks.2: Ahh, it's my salary! Master is the best!
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.thanks.3: I received my salary, thanks master!
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.thanks.4: Hehe, I'll save up and buy master a gift~
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.night.1: It's dark... I'm a little scared...
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.night.2: There are lots of monsters at night... be careful, master.
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.night.3: Before goodnight, let me patrol once more.
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.rain.1: It's raining... my clothes will get wet...
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.rain.2: The sound of rain makes me sleepy...
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.rain.3: This weather is perfect for tea~
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.snow.2: Be careful on the snow, master.
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.snow.3: I want to build a snowman... hehe~
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.morning.1: Good morning, master! Let's do our best today!
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.morning.2: Good morning~ A new day has begun!
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.morning.3: The morning air feels so nice~
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.angry.2: I'm really angry right now! There will be consequences!
Interval (ticks) for the maid to take damage when hunger is 0.
Damage dealt to the maid each time when hunger is 0.
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.hurt.angr: Touch me again and see! I won't hold back!
It hurts so much! Stop it!
I'm not someone you can push around!
Oww! You've made me furious, just you wait!
Don't think I'm that easy to bully!
Oww... why would you do this...
I'm sorry... did I do something wrong...
I wish master would comfort me...
Oww... I feel a bit wronged...
Is it that I'm somehow not good enough...
Stop hitting me... I could really get hurt...
Oww... I want to hide away...
It hurts so much... someone save me...
I'm sorry, I'm sorry... it's all my fault...
Waaah... I want to go home...
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.fed.low.6: Hmph, I won't forgive you for just a little kindness.
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.fed.low.8: Hmph, I'm not so easily bought.
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.fed.low.9: ...Thanks. I'm only a tiny bit happy.
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.fed.low.1: ...You're pretty good at winning people over.
Hmph, don't think this changes my opinion of you.
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.fed.mid.5: Wow, I'm so happy! Thanks, master!
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.fed.mid.7: Mmm, what is this, it's delicious!
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.fed.mid.9: Hehe, I love whatever master gives me~
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.fed.mid.1: Master really gets me, knows what I want to eat~
Wow, I'm full and so happy!
I love master the most! Everything master gives is delicious~
Being with master, everything tastes great!
Mmm... master is so gentle, I'm about to cry~
Hehe, I love everything master gives me!
Wow, master is so nice, I don't want to finish it all~
With master, everything tastes extra good~
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.lowhp.9: Oww... my vision is getting blurry...
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.lowhp.10: At least... let me hold on to the very end...
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.work.9: Hmph, this isn't hard for me at all!
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.work.10: For master, a little hard work is nothing!
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.work.11: A maid who works hard is the cutest!
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.work.13: When master asks, I'll definitely get it done!
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.work.14: Hehe, look how well I'm managing everything~
(fidgets with her skirt out of boredom)...
Hmph, I'm not playing with you.
(turns her head away)...You want me to talk? No way.
Mmm... should I brew a cup of tea~
With master away, it's a little quiet.
Okay, let's tidy up the house while I can~
Hmm... what should I do next~
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.idle.high: Hehe, as long as I'm with master I'm happy~
What tasty thing should I make for master next time~
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.hungry.7: Oww... I really want something to eat...
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.hungry.8: My stomach is growling and howling...
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.hungry.9: Is there any food... I'm so hungry...
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.hungry.10: Mmm... I can't work well on an empty stomach...
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.hungry.11: I wish master would bring me back something to eat...
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.hungry.12: Let me find something to tide me over...
From the moment we made the contract, I belong to master!
Sniff, I'm so glad I met master!
It's a promise, okay? We'll be together forever!
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.strike.5: Without some appreciation, I'll stay on strike!
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.strike.6: Hmph, you want the horse to run but won't feed it? No way!
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.strike.7: You want me to work? Pay me first!
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.thanks.5: Wow, I got it! Thanks master!
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.thanks.6: Master is so good to me, hehe~
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.thanks.7: I'll put this money to good use~
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.night.4: It's getting dark, master, please be careful.
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.rain.4: It's raining, master, don't get wet.
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.snow.4: The snow is slippery, master, stay safe~
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.death.2: I wanted... to stay with master a little longer...
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.morning.4: The early bird catches the worm, master up yet~
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.death.5: In the next life... I still want to be with you...
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.angry.4: Don't mess with me! I'm in a bad mood right now!
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.angry.5: Hmph, keep it up and I'll really get angry!
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.resurrect: Ah... I can see master again...
Mmm... hungry, let me eat something~
Let me refuel a little first~
Let me eat something to recover~
Mmm... this is really good, a bit more~
speech.littlemaidmobresurgence.rebellion: I'll live on my own strength!
You brought this on yourself! Don't blame me!
